name: io.github.DylanCourtney584/slinghook
title: SlingHook
description: Inspect, debug and replay captured webhooks (Stripe, GitHub, Shopify) from your AI agent.

environmentVariables.name: SLINGHOOK_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: SlingHook API token (shk_...). Optional after running `npx slinghook login` once.

environmentVariables.name: SLINGHOOK_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Server URL. Defaults to https://slinghook.co.za; set it for a self-hosted server.
